name: National Bamboo Mission (NBM)
eligibility_facts: all farmers in India stated as eligible
entrepreneurs/private agencies/FPOs etc. also listed as beneficiaries
hard_exclusions: state/UT must be within implementation coverage
questions: Do you want to grow bamboo, set up a nursery, or build a bamboo processing/product business?
temporal_note: Source says NBM was merged with MIDH during 2022-23; treat this as a scheme component/portal mapping issue and verify current state implementation.

description.or: ଉତ୍ସରେ ଏଠାରେ ଆବୃତ୍ତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ତାଲିକା ନଥିବାରୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ରାଜ୍ୟ କିମ୍ବା କେନ୍ଦ୍ରଶାସିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନ୍ୱୟନକୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।
